example_zh: “那件衣服很好看，”迈克尔说。“谢谢，”她严肃地回答。

meaning_zh: v.请求给予（金钱、帮助等）,征求(意见),(妓女)拉客
example_en: We solicit your specific inquiry.
example_zh: 希望接到你们的具体询盘.

meaning_zh: n.初级律师,恳求者，求婚者,〈美〉掮客，募捐人
example_en: The Solicitor General heads the Legal Policy Division, which includes the Law Reform Commission Secretariat.
example_zh: 法律政策科由法律政策专员掌管,辖下设有法律改革委员会秘书处.

meaning_zh: adj.关心的,挂念的,热切的,渴望的
example_en: Knowing that the end was so near, she became rather solicitous.
example_zh: 她知道这一切即将结束, 反倒变得很有些放心不下了.

example_en: What is needed is mutual encouragement, solidarity, and practical organization.
example_zh: 我们需要的是一个互勉 、 团结 、 实干的组织.

meaning_zh: n.自言自语,（戏剧中的）独白
example_en: As he made this dreary soliloquy, he had cantered out of Rotten Row into the park.
example_zh: 他一边这么闷闷不乐地自言自语,一边离开了罗登道,来到公园里.

meaning_zh: adj.独自的，独立的,单个的,唯一的,隐居的
example_en: Solitary pursuits such as reading and sewing.
example_zh: 独自的追求如阅读及缝制.

meaning_zh: n.单独，孤独,偏僻处，隐居处,幽静（的地方），荒野
example_en: They enjoy peace in solitude and hate the hustle and bustle of modern life.
example_zh: 他们喜欢孤寂,厌恶现代生活的喧嚣.

meaning_zh: n.独唱（曲），独奏（曲）,单飞,单人表演
adj.单独的,独自的,独唱的,独奏的
example_en: The Beatles separated in 1970 and all of the members went on to make solo records.
example_zh: 披头士于1970年解散,所有团员继而录制自己的个人专辑.

example_en: With the summer solstice now two weeks gone the northern hemisphere is heating up.
example_zh: luyue翻译夏至过去两个星期,北半球的气温越来越高.
